name: CHIP Application Assistance
description: Helps families apply for children's health insurance support.
eligibility: Families with children and limited income may qualify.

name: Transit Voucher Program
description: Provides bus passes or ride vouchers for medical appointments.
eligibility: Low-income residents without reliable transportation may qualify.

name: Food Support Office
description: Connects families to SNAP screening and local food pantries.
eligibility: Households with limited income may qualify.

name: Prescription Assistance Desk
description: Screens users for manufacturer assistance, generics, and pharmacy discount cards.
eligibility: Uninsured or underinsured residents may qualify.

name: Immigrant Family Resource Center
description: Helps immigrant families find language-accessible clinics and public services.
eligibility: Open to immigrant families and residents seeking multilingual navigation help.
documents_required: No immigration documents required for navigation services
